title: Retain evidence revision pins and enrichment history
preconditions: A separate case r1 has a stable assertion step; save original r1 bytes.

steps.action: Add evidence to r1, revise the assertion outcome to r2, then append evidence superseding the old record.
steps.expected_result: Initial evidence is pinned to r1; revision makes it stale; replacement evidence restores linked stage with two revisions and two evidence records, and original revision bytes remain unchanged.

steps.action: Read public Quality and quality-history output and compare the two evidence records with their authored values.
steps.expected_result: Canonical evidence identity, role, exact code references, pinned test revision, stable step IDs and supersession edge are retained; outdated pins remain visible unchanged.

expected_result: Retain evidence revision pins and enrichment history.
